response.body: [[["Tailor generations to your exact needs","Use Custom Instructions","Guide the model with specific instructions for every app you build.","Save custom instructions to define app styles, frameworks, or other preferences to ensure Gemini builds exactly what you have in mind."],["Never start from a blank page","Explore the App Gallery","Browse and remix a collection of apps built by the community and Google.","Kickstart your project by exploring the App Gallery. Find an app you like, see how it's built, and remix it to make it your own."],["Bring your app to life","Deploy your app","Instantly deploy your application and share it with the world.","Go from idea to live application in seconds. With one click, deploy your app to a shareable URL to test with users and showcase your creation."],["Take your code to the next level","Publish to GitHub","Export your app's code to a GitHub repository to continue development.","When your prototype is ready for a full development environment, publish the entire codebase to a new GitHub repository with a single click."],["Don't let quota break your flow","Use your API key","Switch to your API key when you run out of quota.","Switch to your API key whenever you run out of quota, and we'll automatically switch back to your free quota when it resets."],["Add Vocabulary Flashcards",null,null,"Create interactive flashcards to help users learn new English words and their meanings.",[],"Generate a set of 20 flashcards for English vocabulary. Each flashcard should include an English word, its definition, and an example sentence. Categorize the words by difficulty level (beginner, intermediate, advanced)."],["Implement Pronunciation Practice",null,null,"Allow users to practice English pronunciation by providing audio feedback on their speech.",[],"Create a feature that allows users to practice English pronunciation. The feature should provide an English word or phrase, allow the user to record themselves saying it, and then offer feedback on their pronunciation. Start with 10 common phrases."],["Develop Grammar Exercises",null,null,"Build interactive exercises to test and improve users' understanding of English grammar rules.",[],"Design a set of 15 grammar exercises for English learners. Include a variety of question types such as fill-in-the-blanks, sentence correction, and multiple-choice questions covering common grammatical concepts like verb tenses, prepositions, and articles."]]]
